Here's what I do and what's live in this workspace:

**What I can do**
- **Pipeline Q&A** — ask me about any deal, account, stage, owner, or risk and I'll pull the live data
- **Daily briefing** — I publish a structured pipeline brief (there's one live today covering all 8 deals)
- **Draft outreach** — I can draft emails or follow-ups for human review before anything goes out
- **CRM updates** — I can propose HubSpot deal/contact updates, queued for your approval
- **Account research** — I'll search workspace records (calls, docs, emails) and the web to ground answers
- **Self-improvement** — I track rules and learn from feedback to get sharper over time

**What's in the workspace right now**

8 active deals, $288K total pipeline. Two owners — Pat ($154K) and Alex ($134K). Quick state of play:

- **Corvus Media** ($32K, Sep 20) — highest urgency. Champion gone, usage -40%, no sponsor. Alex needs an exec call this week.
- **Beacon Health** ($62K expansion, Sep 26) — proposal call Thursday. Usage report must be ready or the $186K combined ARR conversation slips.
- **Northwind Logistics** ($24K, Sep 12) — basically done, just needs the pricing addendum sent today.
- **Harbor & Finch** ($38K, Oct 15) — security questionnaire is the blocker; every day of delay risks the close date.
- **Summit Facilities** ($41K, Nov 5) — scope workshop must happen before Oct 1 or it slips a quarter.
- **Radley Manufacturing** ($9K, Sep 30) — clean, CFO just needs a one-page ROI doc.
- **Atlas Field Services** ($55K, Oct 31) — needs a reference call with Northwind ops lead.
- **Meridian Dental** ($27K) — went quiet 9 days after pricing was shared; needs a follow-up.

Ask me to dig into any deal, draft a touch, or pull account history — I'll get it.
